# R5.38 — Directional KL and correctly labelled bounded equivalence

**Spec:** `docs/tickets/208_R5.38__kl.md` (seq 208/246) · **Base:** codex/harnessharness-evidence-r5.37 (`be470636`) · **REQ ids:** REQ-D-304/305/306/307 (primary); REQ-D-008, REQ-D-109, REQ-D-310, REQ-E-209, REQ-H-010 (contributing-only).

## Summary

Lands the GATE-G9-admitted Packet F (PADR-R5-6*) slice: continuous
Bernoulli KL inversion (`stats::kl_directional_bound`, outward-
rounded ppm, `x=0/1` conventions, no libm transcendentals), the
`directional_kl_equivalence` estimator over declared H/O
first-attempt pairs (c+/c− TOST η=.025 ⇒ joint .90; .95 reporting
η=.0125; planned-N completion envelope; bounded absolute and
relative-mean contrasts; zero-reference `absolute` fallback; one
IUT conjunction; selected-claim η/m allocation), and the routed
`directional_kl_equivalence` analysis kind (records-in: filters→decl,
margins only from `PreRegistration.equivalence_margin` via
`benefits::registered_margins`, `AnalysisError::KlEquivalence`,
`record_kind`, `MetadataOnly` gate, additive
`IntervalMethod::KlDirectional`).

## Deviation (conspicuous)

**2,989 changed source/test lines vs the ≤1000 trigger (~3.0× —
ties the R5.29 high-water mark)** — recorded Deviation, accepted
per the scoped AMEND ruling `6a0876af`
(`docs/build/planning/2026-11-03_R5.38-split-review.md`):
the M-E memo binds the slice with an explicit keep-together rule
(:103 — separating label/margin routing from scalar math
"recreates current raw-unit/relative and confidence mistakes").
Packet F's F.2 owner map names the estimator-vs-persistence seam,
but the cut is non-curative — both legs stay over trigger
(~1,829/~1,127) and `directional_kl.rs` has zero `#[cfg(test)]`,
so an estimator-first leg lands with zero fails-without regression
(the R5.22 "documented seam that does not split legally"
precedent). `kl_equivalence()` is indivisible — the IUT
conjunction spans all endpoint kinds. Honest trip: review, not
redesign.

## Design decisions (ADR-0416)

Margins only from `PreRegistration` (F.4/OQ-113); synthetic declared
pairs admissible (authentic capture owed R5.39/R5.47); strict
outward-rounded boundaries; .90 disjoint alone is descriptive;
`{endpoint}:absolute` margin for the frozen zero-reference fallback.
